patches.name: Block Ad Server
patches.description: Stops Nepali Patro's ads. Eight byte-asserted edits to libapp.so plus an in-place host rewrite: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length; the interstitial_html dispatch in the ad-queue callback is retargeted so the full-screen page is never pushed; showHtmlInterstitialAdDialog - the single function that raises the HTML interstitial roadblock - is stubbed out; the popup/popup_html branch is forced down the app's own 'blocked' return; and the five raster formats (slider, banner, popup, card_view, circular) are dropped to the build's own empty-widget tail, so the image creatives Remove Ads cannot see - they are fetched by Dart through CachedNetworkImage, not by a WebView - are never requested at all. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to present the shell at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the HTML creatives and the AdMob interstitials.

patches.name: Enable Online Pro
patches.description: Experimental companion patch that keeps byAir's online Pro status from being downgraded: forces the pro-status sync to always persist isSubscriber = true into the local user table, so a later RevenueCat refresh or a failed network round-trip cannot turn Pro back off.

patches.name: Enable Pro
patches.description: Unlocks byAir Pro: forces the RevenueCat entitlement to "subscriber" and marks the local user as a subscriber, which is what the pro banner, flight-details and flight-time gates read.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Disables all ad serving in Hamro Patro by no-oping the native ad-placement resolver (HamroAdsPlacements). Every banner, native, interstitial, fullscreen and roadblock placement funnels through these leaf builders, so returning an empty list means no ad request is ever built for the bundled MAX, Pangle, ironSource, Facebook Audience, Unity, Vungle and Google Ads SDKs, and no mediation cycle ever starts. Re-verified on v10.7.33. Works on its own, and combines cleanly with Nai64's universal No Ads patch if you have it enabled - the two act on different layers, so together they also cover the Google ads_mobile_sdk layer that no SDK-level patch reaches.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Disables both ad stacks in Nepali Patro: Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) and the first-party flutter_adserver HTML ad server. AdMob's method-channel entry point is short-circuited for every load and show call so no ad is ever created, and the WebView loaders the ad server uses are neutralised - loadData and loadDataWithBaseUrl become no-ops, while loadUrl only refuses the ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np host and data: URLs so normal in-app browsing keeps working.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Blocks all ad display in Provide Lite by forcing the app's central ad gate (in libapp.so) to always take its 'skip' path. Two branch instructions are rewritten to unconditional skips: the global 'ad enabled' flag check (tbz -> b #skip) and the interstitial/rewarded cooldown gate (b.ge -> b #skip). Verified on v1.4.6 (Dart 3.7.0, arm64, obfuscated) — no ad-show invocation is reached.

patches.name: Remove Interstitial Ads
patches.description: Stops the between-games Unity LevelPlay/IronSource interstitial from being loaded or shown. The app's own `mm_noads_new` purchase sets `Settings.playWithJokerOld` to suppress it, so this also gives that paid behaviour to builds without the purchase.

patches.name: Remove Update Prompt
patches.description: Removes byAir's forced-update screen ("Pack up for Update! 🚀" / "Update Now") by pinning its version gate to "no update required". byAir fetches a server-side minimum version code on launch and, if your build is older, blocks the whole app behind a non-dismissible screen whose only action opens Google Play. With the gate closed a patched older build keeps running and never calls the min-version endpoint, so you no longer have to re-patch every time byAir ships a release.

patches.name: Remove Watermark
patches.description: Removes the "PRISMATICA" watermark from the live preview and GPU exports by retargeting the free-tier gate of the procedural GLSL fragment shader embedded in libharwin_native.so: `if (uIsPro == 0)` becomes `if (uIsPro == 2)`, a value the renderer can never pass because the uniform is filled from one native field that only holds 0 or 1. Builds that already gate on `uIsPro == 2` (1.5.8 and later) have the branch unreachable and are reported as already watermark-free instead of failing.

patches.name: Reward when the ad fails to load
patches.description: The reward for a rewarded ad is granted by one branch of the ad listener, and the redemption call it makes (a/redeemAdReward) never checks that an ad was actually shown. This routes the ad-load-failure branch into that same reward call, so pressing "Watch ad" with no ad available pays out instead of showing "Ad Error".

patches.name: Scan camera QR to join Wi-Fi
patches.description:
EXPERIMENTAL. Only one setup has been tested: a ZV-E10 on app 3.6.0 over Wi-Fi Direct (Smartphone Connect). It hooks several internal screens of Sony's app, so a Sony update can break it, and some failures fall back to the stock behaviour without an error. Works together with ZV-E10 Wi-Fi support, which you need to enable as well.

One-step Wi-Fi connection for the original ZV-E10. Scan the QR code the camera shows (Network > Smartphone Connect / Ctrl w/ Smartphone) and the app joins the camera's hotspot, runs its own search, and selects the ZV-E10 for you, so you land on the connected page with Remote Shooting and Import. No typing the password into Android's Wi-Fi settings.

HOW: adds a "ZV-E10" row to the first-time model picker (the stock guide for the Mark II is a Bluetooth pairing that does not work on the ZV-E10) and puts the same prompt in front of the gear menu's "Connect only via Wi-Fi". The prompt offers: Reconnect to the last camera (saved after a successful join, no scan needed), Scan the camera's QR code, or Already connected. Android's own Wi-Fi approval prompt still appears each time.

WORKS: the Wi-Fi QR of Sony cameras that use the "W01:S:…;P:…;C:…;M:…;" format; Remote Shooting after the connection (tested on a ZV-E10, app 3.6.0, Wi-Fi Direct / Smartphone Connect).

CAMERA LIMITS (the ZV-E10 itself; no patch can change these):
- The Wi-Fi QR only exists on the camera's Smartphone Connect screen, so the camera must be showing it every time you connect.
- Bluetooth pairing does not work on the ZV-E10 (its Bluetooth service lacks what the app needs). This patch replaces it with the QR.
- Movies are not copied automatically, and Import and Send to Smartphone only work with PC Remote off (see ZV-E10 Wi-Fi support).

ANDROID LIMITS: Android's own Wi-Fi approval prompt appears every time, Location must be on, and joining does not work while a VPN is on.

NOT COVERED BY THIS PATCH: Import, other cameras, and reconnecting after the camera was restarted were not checked. It adds the CAMERA permission.

patches.name: Skip Public Zone Rewarded Ad
patches.description: Skips the rewarded Unity LevelPlay video that gates the Public Zone matchmaker and reports it as watched immediately, so the room search starts at once. The app's `mm_noads_new` purchase does not cover this ad.

patches.name: Skip hourly gift cooldown
patches.description: Removes the one-hour countdown gate on the lobby gift button, so the gift screen opens on every press instead of after the timer. The window is computed on the device (account.giftTimeStamp + 1 h) - this only removes that gate; whether the server accepts a claim inside the hour is up to the server.

patches.name: Skip mandatory sign-in
patches.description:
Creators' App forces a Creators' Cloud sign-in before connecting a first camera when the region is mainland China, or when a Sony server flag turns it on for other regions. This makes that check always answer "not required", so no region workaround is needed. Sign-in stays available and optional.

SUPPORTED: connecting a first camera without signing in, on any region. First-launch sign-in was already skippable. With this on, the upstream tip of choosing Hong Kong as the region is not needed.
NOT SUPPORTED: Creators' Cloud features (cloud upload, cloud registration) still need an account. Not tested on a device.

patches.name: Unlock Edge
patches.description: Unlocks the Fricam Edge feature for free. Edge is a self-hosted companion sidecar that runs beside your Frigate NVR and streams low-latency + AI-detection frames into the app over WebRTC. Unlike Pro there is no local persistence for Edge: on every RevenueCat sync the app recomputes the "fricam_edge" entitlement and publishes it into an in-memory StateFlow that drives the pairing/settings/diagnostics UI. The patch forces that published flag true so the Edge UI and the self-hosted (edge-local / Frigate-direct) routes open without a subscription. Note: Fricam's managed Cloudflare relay (edge-remote, monthly allowance) is authenticated server-side and is not bypassed - run the open-source sidecar yourself to get the full value.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written by a single PurchaseManager writer; every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static master ProGate. Fingerprints anchor on the stable prefs keys + signatures, so they survive the R8 class/method renames between 1.3.x and 1.4.0.1. The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features and shop items in JellyWatch.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks all premium features in JellyWatch TV. Premium entitlement is server-verified against verify.jellywatch.app and surfaced to the UI as a PremiumStatus data class (isPremium = first boolean field); the patch forces that field to true and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Patches Dart AOT-compiled libapp.so to unlock all premium features. Forces hasPremiumAccess and isPaidUser to always return true by NOPing their ARM64 conditional branch instructions.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces the premium entitlement in Native Camera. Premium status is a local 'is_premium' SharedPreferences flag (in the 'rawcam_prefs' file) read on cold start into a StateFlow. Unlocks RAW DNG, 10-bit/HLG/UHDR video, custom boosted modes and the sub-40-Mbps bitrate cap. It also neutralizes PairIP's Play Store licensing (fired from both Application.attachBaseContext and LicenseContentProvider.onCreate, so a repacked copy no longer gets bounced to the Play Store paywall at launch).

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks every client-side NostalgiaTV Pro feature by pinning the single pro state authority to true, and removes the PairIP Play Store license/paywall wrapper. All pro gating reads one StateFlow (ProStatusRepository.isProUser) that is written through one setter; the setter's argument is forced to true and the flow's initial seed is flipped to true, so the flag can never be revoked. That covers the 10-channel lineup cap, Docker companion link, on-demand library, custom themes, simulated commercials, channel editor, multiple profiles and player controls. PairIP's license check, response handling, paywall launch and error dialog are stubbed out so the app never redirects to the Play Store on launch.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Patches the Dart AOT-compiled libapp.so to unlock all premium / VIP features. Forces the VIP state to always be true by rewriting the constant-pool loads (add xN, x22, #0x30 -> add xN, x22, #0x20) inside the cacheIsVipKey readers (getter + 3 callers). Verified on v1.4.6 (Dart 3.7.0, arm64, obfuscated) — flutter.cacheIsVipKey=true on device.

patches.name: Unlock Premium, Skip Login & Make Free Trial Permanent
patches.description: Patches the Dart AOT-compiled libapp.so of Bolpatra Nepal to skip the login screen, unlock premium/paid features, and make the 7-day free trial permanent. LoginManager::isNotValidatedUser is forced to always return false, lifting the Free-plan paywall and the trial-expiry gate: the trial expiry is computed client-side from the server plan_end_date into statics (isPaid = (plan_end_date - now).inDays <= 0) that only isNotValidatedUser reads, so with it pinned to false the free trial never expires and premium features stay unlocked forever (PPMO/EGP contact redirect, hidden works tab, document download and gallery gates). The isActive() result is left honest so the app stops attaching the invalid Authorization header, and the four login redirects (notice View, document download, gallery, subscription purchase) are bypassed at the branch level so actions run straight through without sending the user to the login page. Verified on v1.1.33 (Dart 3.9.2, arm64, non-obfuscated).

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Forces Atlas Photo's Hermes (React Native) JS runtime to treat every session as a Pro subscriber by patching the setIsProMember store writer, so the isProMember flag is always truthy. Unlocks all Pro features and removes the Pro paywall.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Prismatica Pro by pinning PurchaseService._pro at its single startup writer in the Dart AOT snapshot (libapp.so). The pro flag is a plain bool with no receipt or signature check; `initialize` restores it from one SharedPreferences bool and every paywall reads one bit of it. The patch retargets the null-coalesce branch and rewrites the false literal to the exact value a real purchase writes (NULL+0x20), and does the same in the async catch handler, so no Pro feature can fall back to the paywall. Covered: Batch Export, cross-project grade copy/paste. Grading tools are free and unchanged. Statically and packaging verified on 1.5.8; not yet exercised on a device.

patches.name: ZV-E10 USB support
patches.description:
EXPERIMENTAL. Not yet tested on a device with app 3.6.0; the behaviour below is what the upstream project saw on 3.5.0 with the same changes.

Lets Creators' App use the original ZV-E10 over USB (PC Remote): adds it to the supported-camera list and forces USB sessions into remote-control mode. NOTE: this applies to every camera on USB, so other cameras lose USB contents transfer with it (the app cannot know the model before it connects).

WORKS over USB (camera set to PC Remote: On, Cnct Method: USB): connection, live view and exposure controls, photo capture, automatic copy of photos to the phone, movie recording.

CAMERA LIMITS (the ZV-E10 itself; no patch can change these):
- Over USB the camera only offers PC Remote, and in PC Remote it exposes no storage and refuses to send images. So Import and Send to Smartphone cannot work over USB. Use Wi-Fi with PC Remote off to transfer.
- A movie is never copied automatically after recording: the camera's save-destination setting covers still images only.
- Bluetooth pairing does not work on the ZV-E10, but over USB it is not needed: the camera appears by itself, there is no Add camera step.

NOT COVERED BY THIS PATCH:
- The Import button is not hidden on the USB camera card (upstream hides it; that part is not ported). Tapping it shows a storage error, which is expected.
- Other firmware versions, other app versions, other cameras.

HOW TO USE: on the camera set Network > PC Remote Function to PC Remote: On and PC Remote Cnct Method: USB. Plug the camera into the phone with a data-capable USB-C cable and allow USB access for Creators' App when Android asks. The ZV-E10 then appears by itself on the Cameras tab (no scan, no picker) with a Remote Shooting button. If another app (e.g. Gallery) asks for USB access, tap Cancel, or live view stops until you reconnect. Set Still Img. Save Dest. to PC+Camera so photos also stay on the card. Uninstall the original app first (different signing key).
Support list is from the upstream project (ZV-E10 firmware 2.03, app 3.5.0); it has not been re-tested on 3.6.0.

patches.name: ZV-E10 Wi-Fi support
patches.description:
EXPERIMENTAL. Only one setup has been tested: a ZV-E10 on app 3.6.0 over Wi-Fi Direct (Smartphone Connect). PC Remote over Wi-Fi, Import, other firmware and other app versions are untested, and it may stop working when Sony updates the app.

Lets Creators' App list, connect to and use the original ZV-E10 over Wi-Fi (PC Remote and Smartphone Connect): accepts its protocol version, keeps a PC Remote session in remote-control mode, and enables Import / camera-initiated transfer.

WORKS over Wi-Fi: connection, live view and exposure controls, photo capture, automatic copy of photos to the phone, movie recording. With Smartphone Connect (PC Remote OFF on the camera) also Send to Smartphone from the camera and Import (browse the card from the phone). Upstream saw all of this on 3.5.0; this patch's own device test on 3.6.0 covered connection and Remote Shooting.

CAMERA LIMITS (the ZV-E10 itself; no patch can change these):
- It offers two Wi-Fi services with different abilities: PC Remote (remote control) and Smartphone Connect / Send to Smartphone (file transfer).
- While PC Remote is on, the camera exposes no storage and refuses to send images, so Import and Send to Smartphone cannot work then. Turn PC Remote off to transfer.
- Smartphone Connect works over Wi-Fi Direct only (the camera's own hotspot), not through a router. PC Remote also works through a router (access point).
- A movie is never copied automatically after recording: the camera's save-destination setting covers still images only. Use Import or send it from the camera.
- Bluetooth pairing does not work: the ZV-E10's Bluetooth service lacks what the app's pairing flow needs (it stops right after bonding). Use the Wi-Fi search list, or the QR patch, instead.

NOT COVERED BY THIS PATCH: other firmware versions, other app versions, other cameras.

SETUP (from upstream's testing on 3.5.0): for remote control set the camera's Network > PC Remote Function to PC Remote: On, with Cnct Method Wi-Fi Access Point or Wi-Fi Direct; in the app use Cameras > gear icon > Connect only via Wi-Fi. For transfer / Import turn PC Remote OFF, start Send to Smartphone or Smartphone Connect on the camera, join its DIRECT-... hotspot, then Connect only via Wi-Fi. Set Still Img. Save Dest. to PC+Camera (or Phone+Camera) so photos also stay on the card. Uninstall the original app first (different signing key).
Support list is from the upstream project (ZV-E10 firmware 2.03, app 3.5.0); it has not been re-tested on 3.6.0.

patches.name: ZV-E10 core
patches.description: Shared fixes for using the original ZV-E10 with Creators' App: skips the SDIO_GetDeviceLog request the camera rejects (which poisons the session), keeps a remote-control session out of contents-transfer mode, and starts live view when it is already running. Enabled automatically by the Wi-Fi and USB patches; does nothing on its own.

patches.name: ZV-E10 debug trace
patches.description: Debug only. Logs the app's PTP/IP session with the camera (every operation it sends, whether the camera answered, failed or timed out, and who closed the session) to logcat under the tag ZVPATCH. Use it to find out why a connected camera does not open Remote Shooting or Import: `adb logcat -s ZVPATCH`. Not for everyday use.
